name: Distal 7q11.23 Microdeletion Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Molecular diagnosis by chromosomal microarray or FISH

criteria.description: Detection of heterozygous microdeletion at distal 7q11.23 by chromosomal microarray or FISH
Global developmental delay or intellectual disability
Characteristic facial features including broad forehead, prominent nasal bridge, and thin upper lip

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of genetic confirmation plus developmental delay or intellectual disability
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies primarily on molecular genetic testing; clinical features support but are variable.

laboratory: Possible mild metabolic abnormalities secondary to feeding difficulties
imaging: Brain MRI may show nonspecific white matter changes
Echocardiogram to evaluate for congenital heart defects
genetic: Heterozygous microdeletion at distal 7q11.23 detected by chromosomal microarray or FISH
Deletion size typically ranges from 0.2 to 1.5 Mb
other: Neurodevelopmental assessments confirming intellectual disability or developmental delay
Behavioral evaluations for anxiety and attention deficits

distinguishingFeatures: Cardiac defects including tetralogy of Fallot

redFlags: Severe global developmental delay with regression
Congenital heart defect requiring urgent intervention
references: Morris CA, et al. Distal 7q11.23 microdeletion syndrome: clinical and molecular characterization. Am J Med Genet A. 2015.
Orphanet Report: Distal 7q11.23 Microdeletion Syndrome. ORPHA:254351.
Zarate YA, et al. Neurodevelopmental and behavioral features of distal 7q11.23 microdeletion syndrome. J Pediatr Genet. 2018.
